# Horizon

> Horizon is an adaptive AI mentorship platform by Excentrix. It builds a living model of each learner — competencies, goals, schedule, learning style, emotional state — and generates a personalized learning plan that adapts every day. It combines a conversational AI mentor, diagnostic-based content skipping, SM-2 spaced repetition, and AI-verified skill portfolios in one product.

Key facts:
- Horizon is not a course platform, a chatbot, or a flashcard app. It is a mentor system with persistent memory of the learner.
- Daily tasks are generated from the learner's competency profile, calendar, and recent conversations — no generic templates.
- A diagnostic quiz before each plan removes already-mastered content; plans are 20–40% shorter for experienced learners.
- Spaced repetition (SM-2, the algorithm behind Anki) is built into every plan; learners retain 60–80% of content at 30 days versus 10–20% on standard platforms.
- Every task ties to verifiable artifacts (projects, repositories, analyses) that are AI-verified, quality-scored, and published to a public skill portfolio.
- Conversations are routed by intent: academic, career, and wellness questions each get an appropriate mentor persona. Each learning plan also creates a domain-specialised mentor.
- A "Brain Map" knowledge graph shows learners exactly which concepts they have mastered, which are developing, and which prerequisites are missing.
- Audiences: students preparing for careers, professionals upskilling or pivoting, and educational institutions.
- Status: early access via waitlist. Free for students at launch. Referrals and tasks earn tokens that unlock launch rewards.
